title: Lighting Direct — claimed by thegentlemen
description: NZ · Retail & E-Commerce · lightingdirect.co.nz Lighting Direct is New Zealand's largest lighting specialist, founded in 1974 in Auckland by Bill and Penny Fulford as Keldene Industries and rebranded in 1992, now operating 23 stores nationwide plus an online store.
